issues.detail: The Hebrew 'לְיַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנ֔וֹ' means 'to his son Jaaziah' (i.e., Jaaziah is the son of Merari), but the Chinese renders '雅西雅，米拉利的兒子' which repeats '米拉利的兒子' (son of Merari) after Jaaziah, implying Jaaziah is a separate son of Merari alongside the others, whereas the Hebrew structure lists Jaaziah as Merari's son and then Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri as additional sons. The Chinese adds an extra '米拉利的兒子' that is not in the Hebrew, creating a misreading of the genealogy.
